stream_compactions.scope: Each independently entered region keeps its measured local height and exit-side alignment. Entry cards, source scope, computations and all cross-region dependencies remain present; alignment asserts no scheduling.

stream_selection.scope: One measured alternative keeps independently entered regions at their natural height, aligned on the exit side. Require smaller enclosing-frame area, no longer wires, larger bounds, smaller fonts or added conflicts. Preserve canonical bindings, fulfilled expression/summary goals and realized constraints; otherwise retain equal-height input corridors.

input_placement.scope: At most three multiply used source inputs and three vacant measured positions each. Move only an existing input within its original drawing owner; preserve every use, canonical slot, parent, call, fulfilled goal and realized constraint. Require shorter total wire and no added bounds, conflicts or smaller fonts. No input-role or algorithm inference.
